title: Studio report/widget canvas says a draft dataset "is not defined in this environment" until the package publishes
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgXU26UBEjd1KKHgNEx

Filing gate: ① a user-visible product defect, measured beside #27518 (PR #27575, head `27430e00`) by the card thread's app-showcase acceptance run. reach: every Studio author who binds a report or a dashboard widget to a dataset that is still a draft, which #27575's New dataset makes the normal path.
Business reason: after an author creates a dataset in the Studio and binds a report or chart to it, the canvas shows "Dataset … is not defined in this environment — the app that defines it is missing or out of date". That message blames the environment for something that is only an unpublished draft, and the author cannot preview the chart until they publish.
Reader who acts: the triage seat (first grading), then the implementer for the dataset query path (`@object-ui/data-objectstack` `queryDataset`) and the Studio canvas.
Dedupe words: studio canvas draft dataset not defined, queryDataset previewDrafts, preview=draft dataset query.

## Symptom

The pickers and the Properties panel resolve the draft dataset (they read the draft-overlaid catalog since #27575); the canvas does not. After publish the canvas draws.

## Mechanism

`queryDataset` in `@object-ui/data-objectstack` reads `?preview=draft` off the page URL only. The Studio canvas never sets that URL flag, so its dataset query goes to the published world, where a draft-only dataset does not exist.

Related, code-read only (not run): Setup's dataset designer field catalog (`useDatasetFields`) reads `client.get('object')` without the draft overlay, so a dataset over a draft-only object may show no fields there until the object publishes.
